༄༅/ /dgongs gter bsam pa lhun grub ma'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'beb ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// dgongs gter bsam pa lhun grub ma'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'beb ces bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po snang mtha' yas// nges pa lnga ldan rnam snang spyan ras gzigs// rang byung rgyal kun spyi dpal pad+ma 'byung*// rigs 'dus sku gsum bla mar gsol ba 'debs// chos skyong rgyal po tshangs pa lha'i me tog /mkhar chen mtsho rgyal dge slong nam mkha'i snying*// rdo rje bdud 'joms lha sras mu khri btsan// las can dag pa'i 'khor lngar gsol ba 'debs// zab gter sgo 'byed mang lam bzang po grags// bod 'bangs skyabs gcig rgod kyi ldem 'phru can// 'gro 'dul bka' babs brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan sogs// rtsa ba'i gter brgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs// pad+ma dbang rgyal ye shes rol pa rtsal// chos kyi rgyal tshab rin chen phun tshogs zhabs// chos bdag rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po sogs// bka' 'dus phyi ma'i brgyud par gsol ba 'debs// thugs kyi rigs 'chang la li ta badz+ra// 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po gter bzhad rtsal// thugs kyi sras lnga nye ba'i bu brgyad sogs// byin rlabs dgongs gter brgyud par gsol ba 'debs// yid bzhin nor 'dra ma hā gu ru rje// gang 'dod dngos grub stsol ba'i skur ston pa// gtum drag me phreng dregs pa'i sde dpon brgyad// bcom ldan sman bla de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad// drwa ba sdom pa gnod gnas dbang po brgyad// rdo rje gzhon nu yi dam sgrub sde brgyad// zil gnon drag rtsal gzhi gnas skyong ba brgyad// gsang bdag seng sgrog dpa' bo ging chen bzhi// pad+ma badz+ra khrag 'thung rdo rje brgyad// gu ru rta mgrin gsang ye phyag rgya bzhi// rdo rje gro lota bdud 'dul khro bo bcu// pad+ma rgyal po nye sras sems dpa' brgyad// 'od dpag med mgon mi 'khrugs dpa' bo bdun// kun bzang rdor sems rigs bzhi bdud 'dul bzhi// rtsa ba'i bla ma rig 'dzin slob dpon bzhi// rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba thams cad kyis// mi phyed rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs// chos kyi sdom bzhis srid zhir nges par 'byung*// bsags dang sbyangs pas zab mo'i snod du rung*// gzhi lam dbang bzhis sgo gsum rdo rjer smin// dkyil 'khor rnam gsum 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// byang chub sems dang sgyu lus zab gsal 'byongs// bstan 'tshe'i dmag dpung sdang sems rgyu bcas zhi// mi g.yo bzhir gnas nyams bzhis bdag med rtogs// 'byung 'khrugs bdag 'dzin chom par byin gyis rlobs// zhen med mchod dang sbyin sogs bsdu dngos kyis// dbul phongs zhen chags ser sna'i mdud pa khrol// yon tan kun 'byung bde gshegs snying po'i gter// gcer mthong rig pas thon par byin gyis rlobs// dpyid thig kha sbyor srog rtsol dbu mar thim// 'khrul rtog gis dben bde chen sbas yul phyed// thos bsam sgom pas rtog bcas 'pho ba 'gag

/'brog chen bar dor grol bar byin gyis rlobs// mtshan nyid bzhi ldan rang bab mnyam gzhag la// brtan thob phyi nang 'byung ba'i gegs las rgyal// tshogs drug kun rtog chom po phra sbom rags// spang gnyen gshis thog pheb par byin gyis rlobs// nyon mongs lam lhong ci snang ye shes 'char// rdo rje'i go chas dug lnga'i mtshon rtse gzhom// 'od gsal rnam bzhir goms 'dris brtan thob nas// 'chi ba chos skur grol bar byin gyis rlobs// rmi lam bar do chos nyid sgyu mar rtogs// las rlung gzhir thim gzhi snang dbyings su dag /snang bzhi'i lam nas yid chos 'khrul pa'i tshogs// lhun grub sbubs su 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs// 'khor 'das kun kyang ye shes chen por shar// 'brel bar bcas kun 'di nas 'phos ma thag /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs// gnas skabs su yang mi mthun 'gal rkyen zhi// tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas// rang gzhan don gnyis 'bad med mtha' ru phyin// bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa 'di'ang mkhyen pa'i gter chen rje dbon 'chi med mchog sprul rin po ches bskul gnang mdzad ngor pad+ma nīrte shwa ras yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du tshes bzang por bris te gsol ba btab pa dge legs 'phel//
